 Follow Us On Google South Florida Mansion Designed for Celine Dion Sells for $12.5 Million
 By Casey Farmer 
 October 28, 2026 
 Partner content by 
 Loading... Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group A South Florida megamansion that was once owned by Celine Dion sold in an off-market deal last week for $12.5 million. 
 The Mediterranean-style mansion was, in fact, built and designed for the Canadian singer in 1998, according to  a social-media post  by the seller’s agent Rob Thomson of Waterfront Properties. Dion owned the home until 2002, when she sold it for $9 million, records show. 
 Thomson brought the Jupiter, Florida, property to the market in May for $20 million. It came off the market in August. He didn’t respond to a request for comment. 
 The seller was an LLC tied to Edward St. John, founder and chairman of the Baltimore-based St. John Properties. The LLC acquired the property in June 2021 for $7.6 million, records show. St. John couldn’t immediately be reached for comment. 
 The buyer is investor Myron Miller, according to records, who was represented by Willie Abreu of the Nicolas Group at Serhant. Abreu said the home’s location within the exclusive Admirals Cove community was a big draw for his client.
 Loading... The 1990s mansion was designed for Celine Dion, who sold the property in 2002. Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images Loading... The elaborate interiors were designed for Celine Dion. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Loading... The primary bedroom has a fireplace and access to a terrace. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group “My buyer is huge into golf and has kids, so he loves that the community is gated, and he’s able to get everywhere on a golf cart,” Abreu said. “All the amenities are absolutely beautiful—gym, restaurants, pools—it’s basically resort living.” 
 Another plus for the buyer is that the home is on the water, with access to the ocean, and has a private dock, Abreu said.
 Loading... The primary bathroom has a stone bathtub. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Loading... There is an over-the-top movie theater. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Loading... The home office. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Miller couldn’t immediately be reached for comment.
 The house, which was sold furnished, spans more than 14,700 square feet on about 0.65 acres, which is “significantly larger than most homesites in the community,” according to the listing.
 Loading... The wine cellar. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Loading... The covered patio has an outdoor kitchen. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group Loading... The pool has a water view. Robert Stevens Photography / The Nicolas Group It has eight bedrooms and 11 bathrooms, with a primary suite that features a stone fireplace, a large sitting area and access to a terrace, photos show. Amenities include an over-the-top theater with red velvet seats, a coffered ceiling and a crystal chandelier; a wine cellar; a covered patio with an outdoor kitchen; and a pool and hot tub overlooking the water.
